directAnswer: Commercial photography is professional imagery produced for a business to use commercially — on listings, menus, websites, social media and advertising. CreativeLAB shoots hospitality, villas, food, products and brand portraits for businesses on Koh Phangan, Koh Samui and Koh Tao, delivered edited and ready for every channel.
heroSupport: Hospitality, villa, food, product and brand photography for businesses across Koh Phangan, Koh Samui and Koh Tao — shot for how the images will actually be used.
heroImageAlt: Commercial photographer shooting a hospitality interior on location
overview: Commercial photography is different from a casual photo: it's produced with a specific commercial use in mind — a listing, a menu, an ad, a hero image — and shot, lit and edited accordingly. On islands where most businesses compete for attention on Instagram, Google Maps and booking platforms before a guest ever arrives in person, the quality of that imagery has a direct effect on whether someone books.

We shoot across five commercial categories that cover most of what businesses on Koh Phangan, Koh Samui and Koh Tao need: hospitality interiors and exteriors, villas and real estate, food and menus, product photography, and brand or team portraits. Rather than specializing narrowly, we bring the same lighting, composition and post-production standard to all of them, briefed specifically for each shoot.

Hospitality and villa photography needs to sell a space and an experience — light, scale and atmosphere matter as much as accuracy. Food photography needs styling and consistency across a whole menu. Product photography needs clean, repeatable setups that work across a catalogue. Brand photography needs to represent real people and spaces credibly, without over-staging them. We plan each shoot around which of these it actually is.

Production is based on Koh Phangan, and we shoot regularly for businesses on Koh Samui and Koh Tao as well. Off-island shoots involve a boat crossing and a travel fee, which we'll factor into scheduling and quoting alongside the shoot itself — we plan thoroughly so one trip covers everything you need.

faqs.q: What makes photography 'commercial' rather than just professional?
faqs.a: Commercial photography is shot with a specific business use in mind — a listing, a menu, an ad — and licensed and delivered for that use, rather than being a general photo session.

faqs.q: Do you shoot on Koh Samui and Koh Tao, or only Koh Phangan?
faqs.a: All three — we're based on Koh Phangan and travel by boat for shoots on Koh Samui and Koh Tao, with a travel fee factored into off-island quotes.

faqs.q: How many final images do we receive from a shoot?
faqs.a: It depends on the shoot length and shot list — we'll agree an expected image count during the brief so there are no surprises.

faqs.q: Do you provide food styling for restaurant shoots?
faqs.a: Yes, styling is included as part of food and menu photography.

faqs.q: Can you photograph a villa for both listing and social use in one shoot?
faqs.a: Yes — this is common, and planning for both uses at the brief stage means one shoot day can cover it.

faqs.q: Do you retouch and edit every image?
faqs.a: Yes, color grading and retouching are included in every delivered image, not just a selected few.

faqs.q: How far in advance should we book, especially during high season?
faqs.a: A few weeks' notice is recommended, more during peak travel periods when scheduling fills up faster.

faqs.q: How is this different from your content creation service?
faqs.a: Commercial photography is the specific production discipline; content creation is the broader service that plans a shoot to feed social, advertising and web content together.
